name: Dyn_Body_GetMass
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_inputs. float __thiscall(body), RET 0, ST0, body 00C31FC0-00C31FDC. Returns FLDZ when B+50h bit 0 is set (00C31FC1), otherwise 1.0f/M[+50h] through FLD1/FDIVRP and a float spill at 00C31FD5. CORRECTION to docs/UNIT_CONTROLLER_UPDATE.md, which calls it the inverse mass: M+50h is itself the INVERSE mass (00C37F40 stores 1/mass there at 00C37F53, and 00C41550 multiplies the force by it to get an acceleration), so this returns the MASS and the zero is the static-body guard against 1/0. 004462D0 uses it that way: force = 00C31FC0(body) * 10.0 * submersion / record[+1Ch]. docs/RIGID_BODY_INTEGRATION.md

name: Dyn_Body_SetAngularDamping
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_inputs. void __thiscall(body, float), RET 4, body 00C37DE0-00C37DF3. MOVSS to M[+BCh] at 00C37DE9 and nothing else; it does not clear the wake bits the other mutators do. M+BCh is the angular damping rate both integration phases apply as max(0, 1 - rate*dt). Callers: 004462D0 and 00824B60 only, so no ship hull body sets it. docs/RIGID_BODY_INTEGRATION.md

name: Dyn_Body_SetInertia
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_inputs. void __thiscall(body, const float inertia[3]), RET 4, body 00C37E70-00C37F0F. Per component: UCOMISS against zero with the LAHF/TEST AH,44h idiom; equality takes the JNP at 00C37E8C and stores the FLDZ zero, every other case (NaN included, since unordered fails the test) stores 1.0f/x through FDIVR ST(0),ST(1). The three fields are M+54h, M+58h and M+5Ch, the body-space inverse inertia diagonal 00C41550 reads. Callers 00447510, 00824B60, 0092AAE0, 00937C90. docs/RIGID_BODY_INTEGRATION.md

name: Dyn_Body_SetMass
